text.en:
Section 1 Presidential Decree No. 1548 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. Barangay Kianibong, Kingan, Malinao, Mimbagulang, Purug, Inodaran, Cadayonan, Tagoloan,
Sigayan, Imaon, Marawi, Mago-Ingud, Limonsodan, Pagalongan, Bomalama, Baguiangan, Bayog, Buntong,
Ragundang, Pikutan, Kamadahan, Bantalan, Malobelo, Quiapo, Kalilangan, all in the municipality of Kapai,
Province of Lanao del Sur, are hereby separated from said municipality and are constituted into a separate
municipality in said province to be known as the Municipality of Tagoloan with seat of government at
Barangay Tagoloan."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
